reasoning_content:
Key finding: `/api/v1/auth/app-sign-in` → 401 "Invalid email or password" — so it's a real endpoint, and **signup might be automatic on first sign-in** (app-sign-in may create account) or there's a separate register endpoint under /api/v1.

Let me probe /api/v1 routes: /api/v1/auth/register, /api/v1/auth/sign-up, /api/v1/auth/signup, /api/v1/auth/google.

Also try app-sign-in with real email to see if it creates account (returns token) — maybe it auto-registers.

Let me probe /api/v1/auth/* variants.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && for p in "/api/v1/auth/register" "/api/v1/auth/sign-up" "/api/v1/auth/signup" "/api/v1/auth/google" "/api/v1/auth/me" "/api/v1/projects" "/api/v1/me"; do printf "%-28s " "$p"; code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/c.json -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 20 -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Origin: https://app.claru.ai" -A "Mozilla/5.0" -d '{"email":"x@example.com","password":"Test1234!"}' "https://app.claru.ai$p"); echo -n "POST=$code "; head -c 110 /tmp/c.json | tr -d '\n'; echo; done; echo; echo "=== GET /api/v1/projects ==="; curl -s -o /tmp/d.json -w "%{http_code} " --max-time 20 -A "Mozilla/5.0" "https://app.claru.ai/api/v1/projects"; head -c 200 /tmp/d.json

tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && for p in \"/api/v1/auth/register\" \"/api/v1/auth/sign-up\" \"/api/v1/auth/signup\" \"/api/v1/auth/google\" \"/api/v1/auth/me\" \"/api/v1/projects\" \"/api/v1/me\"; do printf \"%-28s \" \"$p\"; code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/c.json -w \"%{http_code}\" --max-time 20 -X POST -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -H \"Origin: https://app.claru.ai\" -A \"Mozilla/5.0\" -d '{\"email\":\"x@example.com\",\"password\":\"Test1234!\"}' \"https://app.claru.ai$p\"); echo -n \"POST=$code \"; head -c 110 /tmp/c.json | tr -d '\\n'; echo; done; echo; echo \"=== GET /api/v1/projects ===\"; curl -s -o /tmp/d.json -w \"%{http_code} \" --max-time 20 -A \"Mozilla/5.0\" \"https://app.claru.ai/api/v1/projects\"; head -c 200 /tmp/d.json", "summary": "Probe Claru v1 API routes", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "timeout": 250}
